# Belvedere 21

Today 11 am to 6 pm

![Belvedere 21](https://www.belvedere.at/sites/default/files/styles/full_width/public/2022-10/Bel21_0_0.jpg.webp?itok=qYN_q8Br) 

The venue for contemporary Austrian and international art, film, and music. Architectural icon of post-war Modernism.

## Current Exhibitions 

- [**Feminist Futures Forever**](https://www.belvedere.at/en/feminist-futures-forever) — 5 November 2026 - 8 March 2027 — Exhibition — Belvedere 21
- [**Civa 2026**](https://www.belvedere.at/en/civa-2026) — postacceleration — 13 November 2026 - 8 March 2027 — Exhibition — Belvedere 21

**Route Planner**

## Sculpture Garden 

- [**Sculpture Garden**](https://www.belvedere.at/en/belvedere/gardens/sculpture-garden) — The Belvedere 21 sculpture garden showcases works by internationally renowned artists. It is accessible free of charge.

## Blickle Kino 

The Blickle Kino is located in the Belvedere 21 and is the venue for a lively and varied program - with free admission!

- [**Blickle Kino**](https://www.belvedere.at/en/belvedere/blickle-cinema) — Vienna's only remaining and fully preserved 1950s cinema invites visitors with a wide range of programming.
- [**Ursula Blickle Video Archive**](https://www.belvedere.at/en/belvedere/ursula-blickle-video-archive) — We invite you to view our ever-growing archive of contemporary video art that combines research, teaching, and practice.
